Destinations / Kerala

Kerala

Backwaters, tea hills and misty spice country

Best time: September – March. Easy roads, lots of nature and wildlife. Monsoon (June–Aug) is lush but wet.

Highlights

  • Alleppey backwater houseboat day
  • Munnar tea estates
  • Wildlife at Periyar
  • Varkala cliffs and beach

Suggested road trips

Kochi → Munnar → Thekkady → Alleppey

7 days · about 450 km. The classic loop: colonial Kochi, tea hills, spice forests and backwaters.

  1. Kochi → Fort Kochi (15 km, about 1 h)
  2. Kochi → Munnar (130 km, about 4.5 h): Ghat road with hairpins.
  3. Munnar → Munnar tea estates (40 km, about 2 h)
  4. Munnar → Thekkady (90 km, about 3.5 h)
  5. Thekkady → Periyar & spice farms (20 km, about 1 h)
  6. Thekkady → Alleppey (140 km, about 4 h)
  7. Alleppey → Kochi (55 km, about 1.5 h)

Coastal Kerala: Kochi → Varkala

4 days · about 180 km. Beaches, lighthouses and cliff-top cafés.

Before you go

Coast at sea level; Munnar about 1,600 m.

Plenty of pumps.

Narrow, busy roads; ghat roads to Munnar have hairpins. Heavy rain June–August.
